entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 provides a universal memory layer for AI agents that supports multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system for efficient retrieval. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions as editable Markdown files for memory extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It distills lessons from text, code, and conversations into durable memory without requiring external LLM API keys for local extraction.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to support sub-300ms recall at high scale. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, videos, and code via an MCP server.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that stores explicit facts with provenance for shared access across multiple agents. It utilizes a synthesis layer for cited answers and gap analysis, supported by keyword retrieval and a typed knowledge graph.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows through an LLM wrapper designed for disposition-aware response generation. It supports multiple programming languages and offers deployment options ranging from Docker to bare-metal environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based memory library that serves as the foundation for stateful agent implementations. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs to facilitate managed, local, or self-hosted deployment of agent memory services.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a plain markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI for context management.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It includes episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates with MCP, Python SDKs, and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including vector search and structured facts to provide persistent memory via Qdrant and Redis. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy that ensures agents prioritize specific injected context and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that manages filesystem-first artifacts like traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool automatically indexes history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups and natural-language search over gigabytes of past sessions. It ensures safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent tool portability. It utilizes an MCP server integration to support hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses with 97.6% LongMemEval benchmark accuracy. It supports real-time data ingestion from platforms including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is unique for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× while saving up to 36% of tokens. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and tracking knowledge contradictions. It includes a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and uses recency ranking for recall.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search across coding projects.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve persistent knowledge across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and retrieval.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data, reportedly reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It features local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to navigate stored notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to establish bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across different platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch operation. It distinguishes itself by supporting real, immediate event deletion to prevent old summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and handle x402 payments using USDC across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing APIs to charge for services directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and scripts to provide tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls to assist with capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider uses native lifecycle hooks for session-end snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable write outbox caching. It enables cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories generated by other connected instances.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to refine retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing files. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for structured models.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports retrieval via HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index methods. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, incorporating MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit functions as a file-based curation loop that manages versioned markdown memory through a git-backed directory without requiring a database. It utilizes specific 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, proposing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured software development methodology for agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtimes through the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs into formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is available as a CLI or MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to manage verification, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process and optional voice profiles. It functions in rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for Hermes and Claude Code users.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to facilitate collective skill evolution. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. It provides ready-to-paste exports for assistants including Claude, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists from YouTube. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, enabling remote skill registries via Git and S3. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Designed to convert rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents, this workflow includes both Lite and Full modes for varying project scales. It ensures quality through a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to support long-running agents.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production, backups, and cron automation in Portuguese. It facilitates integrations with messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this toolkit enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, and is installable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite features eight specialist skills specifically for the FLUX 3 video suite and prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every execution run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry for reusable AI skills includes a Python client and CLI that supports installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Focused on complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures reliability through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. By filtering skills before LLM calls, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying simplified changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for persistent state management to prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address CVE-driven scenarios ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory and state drift detection between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and can optionally send incident alerts to Telegram or Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final markdown, targeting file sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from the terminal or an AI agent. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable Agent Skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs weekly to detect drift. It uses CI-friendly exit codes to validate skills against runtime-specific profiles, ensuring they remain functional and spec-compliant.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all skill updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, extracting structured data via macOS Vision OCR, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for content creation tasks, including e-commerce material generation and SRT subtitle production.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to handle deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project offers a suite of skills for social data scraping, lead enrichment, and SEO automation compatible with agentskills.io clients. It includes integrated support for MCP servers and provides agents with persistent resources like workspace Postgres databases and shareable dashboards.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is built to be compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent ecosystems following the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification and submission.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows Hermes Agent users to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties over the x402 protocol. It operates without accounts or API keys, utilizing a dedicated wallet key and user-defined price ceilings for automated payouts.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured briefs that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to minimize token usage. It maintains index accuracy by automatically syncing data on every file change to prevent stale information during agent sessions.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that monitors token consumption and costs for Hermes Agent and other AI tools through a TUI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows developers to track their usage metrics over time and optionally share data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML reports for reviewing exported sessions and debugging agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks live token usage, costs, and rate limits for Hermes Agent and over 38 other tools with real-time multi-device synchronization. It provides detailed historical breakdowns by model and session to help developers manage their AI resource consumption.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting AI providers. It assists in building user interfaces by providing structured architectural and design prompts directly to the agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as a CTO and Builder, to autonomously build and deploy applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 skills for tasks like GitHub management and monitoring, requiring human approval only for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-driven themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes Agent terminal interface. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configurations to achieve aesthetics like retro DOS or cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF support, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports browser automation workflows and integrates with various AI providers through external MCP clients.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides a two-tier memory system utilizing knowledge graphs and session caches for platforms like Telegram, Slack, and VS Code. It offers memory integrations for frameworks including Strands, CrewAI, and LangGraph to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of prompts, tool definitions, and agent configurations using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions, pre-commit hooks, and SARIF output to validate Markdown, JSON, YAML, and Python files.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for local configurations and skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local monetization, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime that requires explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, open-mic functionality with wake-word support and adaptive turn-taking for Hermes Agent. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for agent data. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It differentiates itself by providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface maintains 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features and runs the agent in-process without an external API server. It utilizes a three-panel layout to organize sessions, chat, and file browsing for both web and mobile users.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that supports multiple runtimes and unified configuration for 10 communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, usage analytics, and approval gates.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, memory browser, and an MCP catalog into a single interface.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It is highly flexible, running as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container with native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Focused on native Mac performance, this workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes specialized native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI is optimized for chat and memory management, featuring native support for LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to control prompt context through manual or AI-assisted tab scoping while synchronizing conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and offers mobile management for scheduled tasks and server workspaces.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight provides a desktop workspace with one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code, alongside custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search local agent histories and resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this project provides a terminal-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation or admin rights, running via portable Python and Node.js environments. It includes a workflow engine for multi-step pipelines and 100 tools covering TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for the full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
